provenance.title: Mulligan — family-requested character adaptation
provenance.creator: Codex / procedural Blender model and rig for Joshua Broggi
provenance.usage: Created at Joshua’s explicit request from three user-supplied toy photographs for this private family build. Underlying character and reference-photo rights are not claimed as original or CC-BY.
provenance.changes: New iPhone-first Blender mesh and weighted 30-joint rig, olive-to-pink skin, charcoal ridges, yellow teeth and claws. Skull narrowed by 45% and lower jaw by 50% after Joshua’s reference correction; all mouth details and forehead ridges follow the revised shape. One baked six-second idle combines breathing, head turns, jaw movement, planted-foot weight shifts and toe flex; converted through the shared USDZ pipeline.
